## Services

Taitam-D offers Thai massage, deep tissue massage, Swedish massage, aromatherapy massage, hair cuts and colour, Japanese straightening, Nano Hair Spa, facials, Gua Sha, hydration treatments, manicures, pedicures, gel nails, waxing, eyelash extensions, lash lift and tint, micropigmentation for brows/lips/eyeliner, and aesthetic injections.
